plain: A tensor can be assembled from small rules, not just displayed as a table. Each piece says: read one part of the input, multiply by a coefficient, then send the result along a chosen direction. Adding all pieces gives the whole action.
張量不只可以排成表，也能拆成幾條小規則：先讀出輸入的一部分，乘上一個係數，再沿指定方向送出。把每條規則的結果加起來，就拼回完整的作用。
analogy: Think of a sorting station. A reader measures how much arrives along one direction; a belt sends that amount along another. The output arrows $\textcolor{#059669}{e_1,e_2}$ are the basis; the readers $\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^1,\varepsilon^2}$ are the dual basis. Each reader returns 1 on its matching basis arrow and 0 on the other.

想像一個分送站：讀尺先量出輸入在某個方向有多少，輸送帶再把份量送往另一個方向。送出的箭頭 $\textcolor{#059669}{e_1}$、$\textcolor{#059669}{e_2}$ 是基底；讀取用的 $\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^1}$、$\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^2}$ 是對偶基底。每把讀尺讀自己的基底箭頭會得到 1，讀另一支會得到 0。
precise: A coefficient $\textcolor{#2563eb}{T^i{}_j}$ weights the rule $\textcolor{#059669}{e_i}\otimes\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^j}$: read with $\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^j}$, then output along $\textcolor{#059669}{e_i}$. The $\otimes$ sign joins those two jobs. The type $(1,1)$ counts one output-direction slot and one input-reader slot; this tensor takes a vector and returns a vector. Turning the measuring basis changes the readers and coefficients together, so the same physical input still gives the same physical output.

係數 $\textcolor{#2563eb}{T^i{}_j}$ 替小規則 $\textcolor{#059669}{e_i}\otimes\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^j}$ 加上份量；$\otimes$ 把「用 $\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^j}$ 讀取」與「沿 $\textcolor{#059669}{e_i}$ 送出」接起來。$(1,1)$ 表示一個輸出方向位置、一個輸入讀尺位置；這個張量吃進向量、吐出向量。轉動量測基底時，讀尺與係數一起改寫，同一個實際輸入仍得到同一個實際輸出。
example: At 0°, use input $v=(1,2)$. The four pieces contribute $(2,0)$, $(2,0)$, $(0,0)$, $(0,6)$, adding to $(4,6)$. Select 90°: the coefficients and individual pieces change, but the final arrow stays at $(4,6)$.
legend: Here $\textcolor{#059669}{i}$ chooses an output arrow, $\textcolor{#d97706}{j}$ an input reader; $\Sigma$ adds all four rules. The reader-basis pairing $\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^j}(\textcolor{#059669}{e_i})=\delta^j_i$ means “1 for a match, 0 otherwise”, not a metric assumption.
$\textcolor{#059669}{i}$ 選送出的箭頭，$\textcolor{#d97706}{j}$ 選讀取用的尺；$\Sigma$ 把四條規則加起來。$\textcolor{#d97706}{\varepsilon^j}(\textcolor{#059669}{e_i})=\delta^j_i$ 表示「配對為 1，否則為 0」，不是對長度或垂直性的假設。
parts: The amounts in the chosen basis.
選定基底下，每片小規則的份量。
指定送出方向，以及怎麼讀取輸入。
Change the description while preserving the action.
換描述方式，保留同一個作用。
One output-direction slot and one input-reader slot. Some tensors also obey symmetry rules.
本例有一個輸出方向位置、一個輸入讀尺位置；部分張量另有對稱規則。
Measures lengths and angles; a nondegenerate metric also converts vectors and covectors.
量長度、角度；非退化度規也能轉換向量與協向量。
Compares tensors at different points and defines covariant differentiation.
比較不同位置的張量，並定義協變微分。
note: A tensor needs neither a metric nor a connection just to exist. Add them when the problem asks for measurement or comparison across locations.
張量的存在本身不要求度規或聯絡；要量長度，或跨位置比較、做協變微分時，再加上相應結構。
